title: Final gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly calculates final pressure using Boyle's law with initial and final volumes.

title: Right piston force balance
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to right piston, relating sand weight, atmospheric force, and gas pressure force.

title: Left piston force balance
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to left piston, relating spring force, atmospheric force, and gas pressure force.

title: Volume calculations
description: Important: Correctly computes initial and final total gas volumes from given piston displacements and cross-sectional areas.

title: Initial pressure identification
description: Essential: Recognizes initial gas pressure equals atmospheric pressure p₀.

title: Spring displacement recognition
description: Optional: Notes that left piston rise equals spring compression distance.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for spring force (tension vs compression) or misaligns force directions.

title: Volume or area mix-up
description: Pitfall: Confuses cross-sectional areas S and 2S when computing volumes or forces.
